name: SwiftData local persistence
description: On-device storage for the app's @Model types with SwiftData, plus an in-memory container for previews and tests.
usage: Declare persisted plan models as `@Model final class`. In the App type, attach `.modelContainer(for: [Note.self])` to the WindowGroup (or build one with `PersistenceController.container(for:)` to show an error view on failure). Read with `@Query` and write through `@Environment(\.modelContext)`. In previews use `.modelContainer(PersistenceController.preview(for: [Note.self]))`.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify swiftdata` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
